curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: form words using the letters Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee in preparation for reading

mission.title: Aa Mm Tt Ee Word Builders

interactions.prompt: Which letter completes m_t to make mat?
interactions.feedback: Yes! m + a + t makes mat.
interactions.retryHint: Say mat slowly and listen to its middle sound.

interactions.prompt: Join a + t. Which word do the letters form?
interactions.feedback: Correct! The letters a and t form at.
interactions.retryHint: Read the letters from left to right: a, then t.

interactions.prompt: Match each letter group to the word it forms.
interactions.feedback: Fantastic! You joined letters to build three words.
interactions.retryHint: Blend each group from left to right.

interactions.prompt: Which arrangement of Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee forms the word team?
interactions.retryHint: Say team slowly, then find its letters in order.

interactions.prompt: At a Kenyan games day, four children work together. Complete: We are a ___.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the word for people working together.

interactions.prompt: Which list contains only words formed using Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee?
interactions.retryHint: Check that every letter is a, m, t or e.
